-- Original Perl SHA256: 45476e83a8d662a34ad666c00b83c06191d3c532d2056698dc9857122aa51a28

    if e.message:findi("hail") then
        e.self:Say("That's right. Large, cause that's what I be. If'n ya don't like it, or even if ya do, ya best get to the dock on the other side o' this island. Ya never know when Icebreaker is gonna stop by again and ye not wantin' ta miss it.")

    item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end

-- Converted from sources/projecteq/thurgadina/Guard_Dagur.pl
-- Original Perl SHA256: fa9b923c387a88c33ee212857ac2fe2b8e38d15cc0a4cd5dd1d3c71bbc450464
-- Review: changes/p99-conversion-trades/closure-review.json
-- Full source conversion with a boolean presence check, not Perl defined(false).
-- Guard Baldvin is exact NPC 115132 and remains the speaker of his own line.
-- Read-only lookup only; no spawn or actor identity changes.

function event_say(e)
    if e.message:findi("hail") then
        e.self:Say("Greetings and welcome to Thurgadin, " .. e.other:GetCleanName() .. ". Ye best watch yer step on the bridge there, it can be a bit slippery.")
        local entities = eq.get_entity_list()
        if entities:IsMobSpawnedByNpcTypeID(115132) then
            local baldvin = entities:GetMobByNpcTypeID(115132)
            if baldvin then
                baldvin:Say("Aye, we wouldn't want ye fallin into the pit now would we.")
            end
        end
    end
end

function event_trade(e)
    local item_lib = require("items")
    item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end

after.name: Loremaster_Solstrin
after.lua_content:
-- Converted from sources/projecteq/thurgadinb/Loremaster_Solstrin.pl
-- Original Perl SHA256: 4978c1f261eaacece138378db994f21899328e257ac741ba4db0a8289b771b2d
-- Review: changes/p99-conversion-trades/closure-review.json
-- Partial: P99 Hall of Ancestors lore; also recognize documented "I am interested".
-- No eighth-Shawl orders 8896, books 18610/18611, approved shawl 8895 or issue kit 17651.
-- Return offered 1199/8895/8896 unchanged instead of consuming unsupported later hand-ins.

function event_say(e)
    if e.message:findi("hail") then
        e.self:Emote("bows before you and says, 'Greetings to you as well, " .. e.other:GetCleanName() .. ". I have recently heard many tales of your people and their glory. I am honored to welcome you to the Hall of Ancestors. Here our people come to pay tribute to the bravest and wisest of our kin who have passed from this life into Brell's holy domain. If you are interested I'd be happy to tell you a little bit about the heroes buried here.")
    elseif e.message:findi("interested") or e.message:findi("what hero") then
        e.self:Emote("smiles at you, obviously pleased by your interest.")
        e.self:Say("This hall contains the bodies of Dain Frostreavers the I, II, and III as well as his grace Grand Historian Nicmar. There is also an empty bier in the back awaiting the next hero of our people. But the most sacred tomb of all lies right behind me here.")
    elseif e.message:findi("sacred tomb") then
        e.self:Say("In this block of ice lie the sole remnants of our great father, leader, and founder, Colin Dain. While leading our people to the safety of the mountains following the destruction of our beloved Froststone. Colin came to a grim realization. He knew that there was no way our people could outrun the giants and safely get away. And so he took thirty volunteers and led them in a suicide ambush to halt the giants' chase while the rest of our people got away. Without his sacrifice, the Coldain might very well have been wiped out that day. Once we were safe, scouts were dispatched to the battle with the hope of finding survivors. Amidst the field of bodies they found this crown, axe, and breastplate which belonged to our beloved leader. Of Colin's actual body, no remnant was ever found.")
    end
end

function event_trade(e)
    local item_lib = require("items")
    item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end

-- Converted from sources/projecteq/skyshrine/Ruru_the_Cook.pl
-- Original Perl SHA256: 645a762431e7217354837deb89f86a354903f73467f619911fe3c71d826701cd
-- Review: changes/p99-conversion-trades/closure-review.json
-- Partial: standalone cooking hail and non-pie reaction signals 3/4/5; return-only trade.

-- No pie, other reward, faction change, XP, or quest progression is introduced.

function event_say(e)
    if e.message:findi("hail") then
        e.self:Say("Hey there stranger, pleased to meet you. I'm Ruru, I do the cooking around here. I'm the best cook around these parts. So, if you get hungry, you'd best be making sure you're coming to see me.")
    end
end

function event_signal(e)
    if e.signal == 3 then
        e.self:Say("Bah!")
    elseif e.signal == 4 then
        e.self:Emote("grumbles, 'Bah, this still doesn't settle anything Grudash. This stranger obviously has no taste for fine cuisine.'")
    elseif e.signal == 5 then
        e.self:Emote("laughs, 'Don't get me started. You know that my cuisine Is prefered over yours two to one.'")
    end
end

    local item_lib = require("items")
    item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end

after.name: Petcas_Coldbeard
after.lua_content:
-- Converted from sources/projecteq/thurgadina/Petcas_Coldbeard.pl
-- Original Perl SHA256: 24b7007971fb26ec3faf5d1e0e3fe3c812571e26c50957f9ed7ce1e90a1e7ab8
-- Review: changes/p99-conversion-trades/closure-review.json
-- Partial: bounded Icy Mug greeting and Ronodun signal responses; refunds all trades.
-- Special Beans 60290 belongs to Warrior epic 1.5 prequest and is excluded.
-- P99 Souvenir Mugs names Adia, not Petcas, for the 5-gold stein 30145; no duplicate source is invented.
-- Ronodun 115019 supplies external initiation; this script does not spawn or drive that actor.

function event_say(e)
    if e.message:findi("hail") then
        e.self:Say("Hail to ye as well offlander. I bid you welcome to the Icy Mug, one o' the finest establishments for a drink in Thurgadin.")
    end
end

function event_signal(e)
    if e.signal == 1 then
        e.self:Say("What's the rush there, youngster?")
        eq.signal(115019, 1)
    elseif e.signal == 2 then
        e.self:Say("That's not good, the Grand Historian's mighty protective of his daughter. What he do after he caught ya?")
        eq.signal(115019, 2)
    elseif e.signal == 3 then
        eq.signal(115019, 3)
    elseif e.signal == 4 then
        e.self:Say("Well, coulda been worse. A month's worth of sermons is a far sight better than a trip to the bottom of the Dain's well.")
        eq.signal(115019, 4)
    elseif e.signal == 5 then
        e.self:Say("Here ya go, Ronodun, on the house this time. Drink fast, don't need the Grand Historian to come lookin' fer ya...")
        eq.signal(115019, 5)
    elseif e.signal == 6 then
        e.self:Say("My pleasure, son. You just remember to keep me in all those prayers you'll be sayin this month. Hahhahah!")
    end
end

function event_trade(e)
    local item_lib = require("items")
    item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end
